mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to increased wage pressures and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not correlate with positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals increased consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increase > 5% MoM does not correlate with positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decrease > 1% MoM does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a decrease in GDP (GDPC1) signals a monetary tightening cycle during economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition does not correlate with negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition does not correlate with positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increase > 3% YoY does not correlate with positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a monetary easing cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decrease > 0.25% does not correlate with positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
